integrity: Complete formulas and proof are supplied with an exact rational small-order checker. Reproducibility code is auxiliary; all-order proof is analytic. No independent scientific validation has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Valid for n>=3 and independent fair orientations only. Pairwise triangle-indicator independence does not imply joint independence. Exact rank-one covariance is restricted to additive functions of vertex scores. Classical deterministic triad-count score identity is not new; historical priority for the conditional formulas cannot be fully excluded.
title: Conditional triad fluctuations and a Krawtchouk projection for fair tournaments
